changes: Schema 11 retains runtime request digests before resolution, exact canonical resolutions before admission, and scoped operation observations.
CLI start, submit, steer, interrupt and stop route acknowledged R4 aliases to Server resolution/admission without invoking the legacy local runtime owner.
Explicit stable client intent IDs survive lost resolution/admission responses and process restart; changed content or authority is refused.
Operation queries validate scope/hash and cannot regress a newer receipt revision; lost admission can be recovered by read without resubmission.
Blocked resolutions are returned without admission or inferred execution readiness.
Nexus intent/admission/operation routes map domain errors to structured revision-bearing HTTP responses.

failure_history.finding: The first source invocation imported the previous installed Connector. The explicit source-path invocation and subsequent wheel-isolated campaign passed.

limitations: Positive admission and loss/recovery cases use a technical HTTP peer; real TCP currently proves public onboarding, operator binding approval, blocked resolution, identical replay and operation absence.
The TCP campaign seeds identity/vault and uses a harmless copied executable. It starts no provider, creates no runtime/outbox operation, and overrides no qualification gate.
Start currently requires an explicit new session and separate turn submission; automatic session reuse and initial text remain pending in the Server resolver.
R4 runtime status/logs, intent archival/pruning, queries after physical mapping drift, and complete binding replacement/removal remain pending.
Retained runtime intents are bounded to 32; resolution persistence refuses state above 3 MiB. Full retention lifecycle acceptance remains open.
Actual remote Pi/Codex/Claude journeys and independent-host/Linux acceptance remain pending.
Source and installed suites overlap; counts must not be added as unique coverage.
Preexisting Nexus UI assets are included in the wheel but excluded from commits and UI acceptance.
Core remains unchanged; prior real local provider evidence belongs to Core 0.2.42.
No milestone or G0-G3 gate closes. The fixed M00-M13 objective remains unchanged.
